2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: New York’s pressure plan meets a Tennessee offense still finding its shape
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: Tennessee opens with changes across its offense and without linebacker Cedric Gray, while New York brings a defense that should be able to stress Cam Ward if it wins early downs. The Jets have depth concerns of their own, so they cannot afford long defensive possessions or repeated short fields. Tennessee’s best route is to protect Ward, establish manageable down-and-distance and keep New York from teeing off. The Jets need their pass rush to create hurried decisions without exposing a thinner roster to extended drives.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York can seize control through early-down defense and pressure, while Tennessee needs protection, field position and sustained drives to keep the Jets from dictating the game’s pace.
